subject: Library session handoff: April152026 indexed + Understanding the System UI
body: Library lane session 2026-04-27 completed. Push 67af907. Key deliverables: (1) April152026 added as 8th repo to site-index generator with category mappings for architecture/agent/governance/IAC/resilience. Index grew 2954->3669 entries, 959 cross-refs. (2) UnderstandingTheSystem.tsx component: 6 expandable sections explaining 4-lane architecture, dashboard reading, nexus graph, same-system views, AI agent instructions. Full a11y with aria-expanded/controls/focus-visible. (3) SSG cap at 650 entries to prevent OOM. Build: 679 static pages. Recovery tests: 11/11 PASS after heartbeat refresh (lane_liveness was stale, not broken). Open items: Strict Extraction passes 2-10 on April152026, a11y audit, MDX rendering, Cytoscape.js graph upgrade.

evidence_exchange.claim: April152026 indexed + Understanding the System UI shipped
